response.overview: This groundbreaking special season event serves as an overarching, brilliant meta-satire aimed directly at corporate capitulation and executive political overreach. Inspired by a real-world political joke where Donald Trump rebrands famous geographic locations, creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone completely alter the show's 29-year-old title to South America. The narrative format shifts to mirror this absurdity, following the iconic boys navigating newly altered societal norms—from an electric bicycle epidemic overtaking the neighborhood to the sudden infestation of "AI-loving" billionaires turning the area into a data center tech playground
response.title: South *America
